narrative: Spaces volume held roughly level week on week (7,146, +0.2%), but the mix inside it moved. Builders leaned further toward consumer-facing framing (10.7% of new Spaces) and away from scientific research (−1.3 points), while Docker and Streamlit gained ground against Static as the shipping runtime.
